snippet.title: Teardown Rally – FREE Update! Release Date Revealed: December 8!
snippet.description:
The countdown is ON!

Teardown Rally launches December 8 at 2 PM CET on PC, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S simultaneously!

Race, wreck, sabotage and help your team take the win. Behind the wheel or on foot, there's more than one way to cause chaos!

And it's completely FREE!


Stay Connected
X: https://x.com/teardowngame 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/teardowngame
